_comment: Where it does not belong (Jonah, 2026-10-16; notes/strange-words-plan.md 4), and visibly: a player cannot
see what should have been somewhere, so this is nonsense or it is nothing. `incongruous` is one name on the
land, the biomes, what grows, what lives and what is built.
- `incongruous landmass` reads patches of the Age's own terrain from far away, so the land breaks off at a
patch's edge -- the foreign-ground step at its widest, written on purpose.
- `incongruous biomes` stops the biomes following the shape of the land (`footing: free`, as `dreamlike`
says it): ocean biomes on hilltops, deserts in the sea.
- `incongruous features` grows every biome's features in every biome, at any height: ore anywhere, trees out
of their biomes. Yema keep to where they grow.
- `incongruous spawns` offers every biome's creatures everywhere and past their own rules: fish on hillsides,
monsters at noon. Scarabs keep their own.
- `incongruous structures` builds in any biome and at any height: a taiga village on the plains, a trail ruin
out of the ground, an ancient city in the open.
